summary: Frontend-only verification of the Leads page donut chart changes. Login as admin worked; navigated to /app/leads. Custom legend (data-testid='pie-legend') renders exactly as specified for all three charts (Affiliates/Funis/Vendedores) with color dot, name, 'N vendas', EUR value, and percentage in gold (#D4AF37). Header total 'N vendas' (data-testid='pie-total-vendas') renders correctly on all three charts ('3 vendas'). Vendedores chart correctly shows sellers with counts (Victor 2 vendas / Ana 1 vendas) matching the /api/leads/stats top_sellers response. No console errors observed. However, the in-slice percentage labels (the white bold '%' text placed inside the donut arcs by the renderLabel function) do NOT render — an SVG-wide scan found 0 <text> elements in every recharts svg on the page, and the zoomed screenshot confirms the donut arcs render without any labels inside them. Everything else in the requested change works.

ui_bugs.issue: Percentage labels inside donut slices are not rendered. With recharts 3.6.0 the `<Pie label={renderLabel}>` function-as-label pattern is not producing any <text> elements. Legend percentages render fine; only the in-arc labels are missing. Likely recharts v3 API change — try passing the label as an element (e.g. `label={<CustomLabel />}` where CustomLabel is a component reading props via context) or use `<LabelList dataKey="value" content={renderLabel} />` inside <Pie>, or force it with `isAnimationActive={false}` + returning a group. Reproduced with seeded data (3 leads, values 1200/800/300 → 52%/35%/13%, all should be rendered since >6%).

After fix, re-verify that SVG contains <text> nodes with '%' for slices >=6%.

rca of the issue: recharts 3.x changed how the `label` prop is resolved on <Pie>. When a plain function is passed as `label`, the function may not be executed as a valid Label renderer. Recommended fix: convert renderLabel into a named component `const RenderLabel = (props) => (...)` and either pass it as `label={<RenderLabel />}` OR use `<LabelList dataKey="value" content={<RenderLabel />} />` as a child of <Pie>. The legend/tooltip continue to work because they use different APIs.
